subject: Subprocessor blackline — onboarding, DPA flow-down & order form handoff
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Blake <tom.blake@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-10-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Subprocessor blackline — onboarding, DPA flow-down & order form handoff

Hi Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, Acme wants to add EdgeCache Inc. as a new subprocessor under the Order Form for the CDN/cache component. That triggers two asks on our side:

1) confirmation of flow-down: we need EdgeCache to accept the DPA security obligations in writing or via a flow-down clause in the Order Form/Annex;
2) evidence: please confirm the most recent SOC 2 report or equivalent, and whether EdgeCache will handle logs containing customer PII (yes/no + retention windows).

I've attached the current redline of the Order Form we received from Acme (acme_orderform_v3_redline.docx). Can you check with your legal ops and EdgeCache and confirm back by EOD Wednesday? If there are specific clauses they can't accept, list them — we can evaluate exceptions (procurement/legal) or propose mitigations.

From a sales timeline perspective, Acme expects the signed order by 10/20 to hit their Q4 deployment; please flag any gating items.

Thanks — I’ll loop in Legal for quick turnaround.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123
[Attachment: acme_orderform_v3_redline.docx (docx, 420KB)]
From: Tom Blake <tom.blake@acmecloud.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Cloud Legal <legal@acmecloud.com>
Date: 2025-10-09T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Subprocessor blackline — onboarding, DPA flow-down & order form handoff

Thanks Jasmine — appreciate the clear ask.

EdgeCache will be the subprocessor. Quick answers up front:
- SOC 2 Type II available (most recent: 2025-06). We can provide a redacted report; ops@edgecache.io will send it.
- EdgeCache will process logs that may contain customer identifiers; retention currently set at 90 days.

Our legal team attached a brief blackline to your Order Form and added a proposed flow-down clause referencing the Acme DPA. See attached: edgecache_sow.pdf (contains EdgeCache SOW + proposed clause).

Question for Redwood: is a 90-day retention acceptable? Also, Acme Legal flagged the 30-day prior notice for subprocessor addition as too tight in their view — they want 60 days for enterprise customers. Can Redwood accept 60 days or propose alternative controls (e.g., emergency onboarding with carry-forward mitigation)?

I'll have ops@edgecache.io share SOC documentation. If you want, we can do a 30-minute triage call today at 3pm PT.

Best,
Tom 
Tom Blake
Sr. Product Ops, Acme Cloud
Tom.Blake@acmecloud.com
[Attachment: edgecache_sow.pdf (pdf, 180KB)]
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-10-09T12:40:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Subprocessor blackline — onboarding, DPA flow-down & order form handoff

Jasmine / Karthik —

Thanks for the context and the attachments. Quick legal read and proposed path:

- Flow-down: we should require an explicit flow-down clause in the Order Form that: (a) obligates EdgeCache to comply with the DPA obligations applicable to Redwood; (b) grants Redwood the right to audit (or rely on attestation such as SOC 2); and (c) requires equivalent data protection obligations for subcontractors. I drafted language in a blackline (attached: redwood_blackline_msa_vs_acme.docx).
- Notice period: 60 days is reasonable for enterprise customers; we can agree to 60 days but keep an emergency carve-out: 10 business days for security patches/critical infra changes with documented justification and prior notification to Acme Legal within 24 hours of activation. This preserves Acme's control and gives Redwood operational flexibility.
- Retention: 90 days for logs is acceptable provided EdgeCache documents access controls and segregation for PII. Ask for encrypted-at-rest confirmation and data residency statement (US-only vs multi-region).
- Evidence: accept redacted SOC 2 Type II report; if the report is older than 12 months then require a compensating control (e.g., quarterly vulnerability scans shared for 6 months).
- Order Form amendment mechanics: require an executed amendment or DocuSign sign-off for any subprocessor addition that materially changes data flows. We should not rely on email-only consent for final acceptance.

Action items for Sales (Jasmine):
1) Confirm whether Acme will accept the 60/10-day hybrid notice approach;
2) Confirm EdgeCache retention/regionality and provide SOC 2 docs (ops@edgecache.io);
3) If Acme pushes back on DocuSign, tell them we can accept signed amendment via their contract system but need a trackable signature.

I recommend we schedule a 30-minute contract triage after we receive EdgeCache SOC and their redline positions on the blackline clauses I added. If Karthik can check whether this deal needs any procurement SSO or fedramp exceptions, flag now.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
[Attachment: redwood_blackline_msa_vs_acme.docx (docx, 125KB)]
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Blake <tom.blake@acmecloud.com>, Acme Cloud Legal <legal@acmecloud.com>

Date: 2025-10-10T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Subprocessor blackline — onboarding, DPA flow-down & order form handoff

Tom / Acme Legal —

Following Laura's guidance, Redwood can accept the 60-day notice as a baseline but needs the emergency carve-out (10 business days) for critical infra patches with post-hoc justification. We also require an executed amendment (DocuSign link below) for the subprocessor addition — please have Acme Legal sign via DocuSign so procurement can close FYQ4.

Quick answers to your asks:
- Retention: EdgeCache confirmed 90-day log retention and encrypted-at-rest in the US only. Ops will send the SOC 2 redacted report by end of day.
- We will route the redlined blackline back to you today as well; if Acme wants to negotiate a particular subsection in Appendix A (audit-rights vs reliance on SOC), call out the clauses and we'll triage.

DocuSign link (order form amendment): https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/ACME-3784-orderform (also attached in docusign-acme-orderform-link.txt)

Proposed mutual action plan:
- 10/10: DocuSign sent to Acme Legal (done)
- 10/11: EdgeCache SOC 2 copy delivered to Redwood (pending)
- 10/13: 30-minute triage call if Acme has redline comments (we're available 10/13 9–11am PT)
- 10/16: Final sign-off target to keep your Q4 deployment on schedule
